parcel_sources_found.name: FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_EXT
parcel_sources_found.description: Audit external table over the warehouse-interop plane of Franklin County Auditor tax parcels (append-only S3 Parquet, artifact=normalized). Grain: one parcel polygon per (release, provider_feature_id). Carries every Auditor field (DBF names), WGS84 WKT, centroid, bbox, H3 r4/r7/r8, the CRS admission evidence, the transform ids, and the evidence-plane locator. Public record; Franklin County Auditor disclaimer (no warranty, primary source controls); attribution: Franklin County Auditor, Ohio - Real Estate Division / GIS.

parcel_sources_found.name: FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_FEATURE_H3_COVERAGE
parcel_sources_found.description: Native H3 r8 overlap coverage bridge keyed by (release, provider_feature_id, h3_resolution, h3_cell) for point-in-parcel candidate generation. Clustered by (release, h3_resolution, h3_cell).

parcel_sources_found.name: FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_FEATURE_H3_COVERAGE_EXT
parcel_sources_found.description: Audit external table over the parcel polygon H3 r8 coverage bridge (overlap mode: every cell touching the polygon) used to bound point-in-parcel candidates before exact GEOGRAPHY predicates.

parcel_sources_found.name: FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_GEOMETRY_EVIDENCE_EXT
parcel_sources_found.description: Source evidence plane under contract geom-v1: decoded EPSG:3735 parcel geometry as base64 2D ISO WKB with per-feature digests, plus the derived WGS84 WKB. Scanned only when source vertices are needed; reach it through the (release, release_dt, h3_r4, geometry_evidence_part, source_row_number) locator on the interop plane, never by scanning this table directly.

parcel_sources_found.name: FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_HOT
parcel_sources_found.description: Native Snowflake hot table for Franklin County tax parcels: every Auditor field (DBF names with the Auditor's aliases in the column descriptions), WGS84 GEOGRAPHY + parse status, centroid, bbox, H3 r4/r7/r8 (hex + conformed integer), bitemporal release columns, CRS admission evidence, the evidence-plane locator, and transform ids. Clustered by (release, h3_r7). Merge key (release, provider_feature_id). Public record; Franklin County Auditor disclaimer (no warranty, primary source controls); attribution: Franklin County Auditor, Ohio - Real Estate Division / GIS.

parcel_sources_found.name: FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_MANIFEST_EXT
parcel_sources_found.description: JSON release manifests: Hub headers, archive bytes/SHA256, feature and live layer counts, schema hash, transform ids, observed digest chains, and landed parts.

parcel_sources_found.name: FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_META_EXT
parcel_sources_found.description: Provenance sidecars for raw archives, Parquet parts, receipts, and manifests.

parcel_sources_found.name: FRANKLIN_COUNTY_AUDITOR_PARCELS_TRANSFORM_RECEIPT_EXT
parcel_sources_found.description: One JSON receipt per (release, transform execution): the pinned PROJ operation, pipeline, grids and their digests, engine versions, serialization policy, and observed feature/vertex counts with digest chains. Join geometry rows on transform_execution_id; transform_definition_id is a sameness claim shared across releases.

parcel_sources_found.name: NYC_DCP_MAPPLUTO_EXT
parcel_sources_found.description: WAREHOUSE INTEROPERABILITY PLANE. Audit external table over normalized clipped MapPLUTO Shapefile rows. Geometry here is DERIVED evidence: WGS84 WKT with bbox and centroid, produced from the source-coordinate geometry by the coordinate operation named by transform_execution_id. Use it for discovery, pruning, maps and cross-source joins. It does not replace and must not be mistaken for the source plane: the source vertices live in nyc_dcp_mappluto_geometry_evidence_ext, reachable by the (release, release_dt, borough, geometry_evidence_part, source_row_number) locator these rows carry. release_dt is the provider release watermark.

parcel_sources_found.name: NYC_DCP_MAPPLUTO_GEOMETRY_EVIDENCE_EXT
parcel_sources_found.description: SOURCE EVIDENCE PLANE. Row-addressable source-coordinate geometry for every admitted MapPLUTO feature, captured BEFORE reprojection, plus the WGS84 derivation and both digests. source_geom_wkb is a deterministic decoding of the retained provider archive under contract nyc_dcp_mappluto_geometry_evidence.v1 - it is NOT the provider's original byte stream, and its hash proves equality of that pinned representation, not world truth. Authority for the source bytes stays with the artifact=raw object named by source_archive_s3_key / source_archive_sha256. Scan only via the bounded locator from nyc_dcp_mappluto_ext; never sweep it whole.

parcel_sources_found.name: NYC_DCP_MAPPLUTO_GEOM_V3_EXT
parcel_sources_found.description: WAREHOUSE INTEROPERABILITY PLANE, re-derived under contract nyc_dcp_mappluto_geometry_evidence.v3. Same projection as nyc_dcp_mappluto_ext plus the geometry-evidence columns, but every row was produced by the PINNED coordinate operation named in its transform receipt (NAD83 to WGS 84 via the HPGN grid, declared 2.0 m) rather than the null transform (declared 4.0 m) that produced nyc_dcp_mappluto_ext. The two tables differ by roughly 5 cm per parcel and are deliberately kept separate so a query can never mix coordinate operations. This is the plane new work should read; nyc_dcp_mappluto_hot and the OC-0048 consumers have NOT been cut over to it yet.

parcel_sources_found.name: NYC_DCP_MAPPLUTO_HOT
parcel_sources_found.description: WAREHOUSE INTEROPERABILITY PLANE. Native MapPLUTO geometry hot table with WGS84 GEOGRAPHY, bbox, centroid and H3 columns for OC-0048 point-in-polygon consumers. GEOGRAPHY is derived evidence, not world truth and not the source plane; carry transform_execution_id when a result has to be defensible.

parcel_sources_found.name: NYC_DCP_MAPPLUTO_TRANSFORM_RECEIPT_EXT
parcel_sources_found.description: TRANSFORM RECEIPTS. One row per release/variant transform execution, naming the exact coordinate operation applied (PROJ pipeline, declared accuracy, selection rule), the sha256 of every PROJ grid it depended on, the pinned decoder/engine/CRS-database versions, and the observed feature and vertex counts with source and derived digest chains. Rows in the geometry tables reference transform_execution_id rather than duplicating this document. Two ids: transform_execution_id is unique per release and source archive and is the join key; transform_definition_id addresses the pinned operation alone and is SHARED by releases transformed identically, so joining on it alone fans out across releases. degraded_transform_accepted = TRUE means a more accurate operation existed but its grids were absent from that runtime - treat those coordinates accordingly.
